compositionRules.assert: Page-level region composition must go through Layout's named slots (header, sider, content, footer) rather than free absolute positioning.
Use hasSider on the Layout wrapper when nesting a Sider region so the horizontal flex direction is applied.
compositionRules.condition: when a Sider is rendered inside Layout

hardRules.message: hasSider must be omitted or a boolean; it is a hint that Layout contains a Sider child.

hardRules.expr: slots.header and slots.footer imply horizontal/single-row regions; do not nest another Layout in header without explicit grouping
hardRules.message: Header and Footer are single-region horizontal containers; do not treat them as multi-region flex parents.

hardRules.expr: no node under content/header/sider/footer carries free absolute positioning (style.position='absolute'/'fixed')
hardRules.message: Layout is the single source of truth for placement; free absolute/fixed positioning inside regions is forbidden.

meaning.definition: Establishes the page-level structural skeleton: a top-level region container that arranges primary regions (header, sider, content, footer) into a coherent application shell so each region occupies an unambiguous place in the spatial hierarchy.
doNotUseWhen: A single inline UI block without page-region semantics (use Card or section instead).
Positioning a single decorative element that does not warrant a named page region.
Creating one-off absolutely positioned overlays (use Modal or Popover).
useWhen: Assembling the top-level application shell (header + sider + content + footer).
Defining a distinct page region that other content slots into (header bar, sidebar, main content, footer).
Establishing the spatial hierarchy before placing interactive content.

hasSider.description: Hint that the Layout contains a Sider child. Sets the Layout's flex direction to row so a Sider region renders alongside content; omit when there is no Sider.

softRules: Prefer composing regions with the named Header/Sider/Content/Footer slots over arbitrary nesting.
Set hasSider on the outer Layout whenever a Sider is present so the row layout applies automatically.
Avoid overriding root.fill; let the layout background token drive the region surface so the skeleton stays token-driven.

semantics.header-content-footer: Vertical page shell with a top header, main content, and optional bottom footer.
semantics.header-content: Minimal shell with a header and a single content region.
semantics.hasSider: Side-by-side shell: a Sider region plus a nested content area; selected via hasSider=true.
